name: @arraypress/clean-link
description: Take the tracking out of a link, offline: tracking parameters, redirect wrappers, Amazon and eBay slugs, share fragments. A port of swift-url-kit's URLStripper, held to its output.

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && node --test tests/*.test.js && npm run duplication
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && diff -r -x '*.js' .types src && rm -rf .types

author: David Sherlock
